##### Project general facts

O Ten Tower is a contemporary residential development, located in the vibrant district of Oud Metha within Dubai Healthcare City. The project features a striking 10-storey structure with a modern architectural design that combines clean lines and functional layouts. It offers a selection of studios, as well as one- and two-bedroom apartments, all thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and everyday comfort, creating a refined and practical urban living environment.

Residents benefit from a range of amenities designed to enhance both relaxation and active lifestyles. The development includes an infinity swimming pool with a wooden deck lounge area, landscaped walkways with water features, and a fully equipped gym with panoramic city views. Additional leisure spaces and green areas create a спокой and balanced atmosphere, while the central location ensures convenient access to key destinations, healthcare facilities, and lifestyle attractions across the city.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, reflecting a modern and comfortable aesthetic. Apartments feature fully equipped kitchens with white goods, ensuring practicality for daily living. All units are offered fully furnished, providing a ready-to-move-in solution that complements the project’s contemporary style and convenient lifestyle offering.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Healthcare City (DHCC) is a unique and specialized healthcare community located in the heart of Dubai. It is a dedicated district that brings together a comprehensive range of healthcare services, facilities, and institutions, making it a leading destination for medical tourism, education, and research in the region.

The project is designed to foster the highest standards of healthcare delivery and promote innovation in the medical field. The district is home to a diverse range of healthcare providers, including hospitals, clinics, specialized centers, and medical universities. These institutions offer a wide spectrum of medical specialties and services, ranging from primary care to advanced treatments and surgeries.

Dubai Healthcare City is strategically located, providing easy access to other key areas of Dubai. It is well-connected through major highways and public transportation networks, making it easily accessible for patients seeking specialized care and healthcare professionals commuting to their workplaces.
